rules.title: Use auto-imports
rules.text: Rely on Nuxt auto-imports for composables and components instead of manual imports.

rules.title: useFetch for data
rules.text: Fetch with useFetch or useAsyncData instead of a bare $fetch in setup, so server-rendered data is not requested a second time on the client.

rules.title: Runtime config for secrets
rules.text: Keep secrets in runtimeConfig private keys and only public keys in runtimeConfig.public.

rules.title: Server routes
rules.text: Put backend logic in server/api handlers with validated input.
